mapper.select: SELECT r.INSTITUTION_ID, r.RUN_ID, r.STATUS, r.PENDING_GATE, r.UPDATED_AT FROM ORCH_RUN r WHERE r.CREATED_AT = (SELECT MAX(x.CREATED_AT) FROM ORCH_RUN x WHERE x.INSTITUTION_ID = r.INSTITUTION_ID) ORDER BY r.INSTITUTION_ID, r.RUN_ID
SELECT INSTITUTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS VAL FROM BID_CASES GROUP BY INSTITUTION_ID
SELECT INSTITUTION_ID, PARTICIPATION_STATUS AS VAL FROM BID_CASES WHERE SEQ_NO IN (SELECT MAX(SEQ_NO) FROM BID_CASES GROUP BY INSTITUTION_ID)
SELECT DISTINCT b.INSTITUTION_ID AS INSTITUTION_ID, t.ASSIGNEE AS VAL FROM TASKS t JOIN BID_CASES b ON b.BID_CASE_ID = t.BID_CASE_ID WHERE t.ASSIGNEE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.INSTITUTION_ID, t.ASSIGNEE
